2h-3"></path></svg></button></div></div></div></div></figure><p>Today we’re launching Team Bots, Grok Bots that work and learn alongside your team. Give one access to the files, apps, and expertise it needs, then share it so everyone can work from the same context.</p><p>At SpaceXAI, Team Bots brief account teams each morning, coordinate engineering projects, and answer data questions across the company. Here’s how they work, how we use them, and how to build one for your own workflow.</p><h2 id="team-bots-bring-context-tools-and-memory-together"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#team-bots-bring-context-tools-and-memory-together">Team Bots bring context, tools, and memory together</a></h2><p>You build a Team Bot around a role or workflow your team shares. Everyone gets access to the same Bot and its expertise, while still being able to work with it individually.</p><p>Every Team Bot brings together four things that help it do its job:</p><ul>
<li><strong>Context</strong> gives it the relevant files, instructions, and skills, from brand guides to internal documentation.</li>
<li><strong>Plugins</strong> let it work in applications such as Salesforce, Notion, and GitHub. They can be connected by each person or configured for the whole team.</li>
<li><strong>Credentials</strong> let it securely access third-party APIs that do not have a plugin.</li>
<li><strong>Memories</strong> help it retain what it learns and improve at its role over time.</li>
</ul><p>Although the Bot is shared, each person’s conversations with it remain private. The Bot keeps separate context and memories for each user while drawing on the skills shared across the team.</p><p>Teams can also collaborate with a Team Bot in Slack. Each Team Bot has its own handle, so you can invite it to a channel where everyone can ask questions, contribute context, and see its responses.</p><h2 id="team-bots-take-on-work-across-spacexai"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#team-bots-take-on-work-across-spacexai">Team Bots take on work across SpaceXAI</a></h2><p>At SpaceXAI, we’re using Team Bots in some of our most context-heavy workflows. Here are four examples from Sales and Customer Success, Product and Engineering, Marketing, and Data Analytics.</p><h3 id="sales-and-customer-success"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#sales-and-customer-success">Sales and Customer Success</a></h3><p>At SpaceXAI, every major sales account has a dedicated Team Bot. Each Bot is shared by the account executive, customer success manager, solutions architect, and sales leader.</p><p>Every night, the Bot reviews company news, recent Gong calls, Notion docs, and relevant Slack threads. Each morning, it posts a briefing in the account’s Slack channel with what changed and what each person should do next, including drafts tailored to their role.</p><p>Throughout the day, account teams use the Bot in Slack to assess strategy, check its thinking against account data, and plan next steps. The Bot remembers the decisions teams make and builds rich context over time. As people rotate on and off the account, it becomes the system of record and can quickly bring new team members up to speed.</p><p>Harper, an insurance company serving small businesses, built a Team Bot to identify customers with lapsed policies and help them reinstate their coverage, reducing manual work for its team and recovering substantial savings for customers.</p><figure class="not-prose border-border my-12 border-l pl-6 sm:my-16 sm:pl-8"><blockquote class="font-display text-primary/85 text-xl leading-snug tracking-tight sm:text-2xl">“<!-- -->We initially had to manually check every customer through three platforms, get their balance details, and send them personalized emails. We built a Team Bot in 24 hours to automate this, saving our customers over $120,000 from hundreds of policies. This is now an ongoing engine for us, saving us time and our customers&#x27; money.<!-- -->”</blockquote><figcaption class="text-primary/40 mt-5 text-sm"><span class="text-primary/60 font-medium">Dakotah Rice</span>, CEO, Harper</figcaption></figure><div id="customer-bot" class="not-prose bg-card my-8 grid scroll-mt-24 grid-cols-[auto_minmax(0,1fr)] items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-3 one customer account. It keeps the AE, CSM, SA, and Sales Leader on the same page, posts a weekday morning brief, and drafts each person&#x27;s next move.</p></div><a aria-label="Add Customer Bot to Grok Bot" data-track="team-bots-blog-add-customer-bot" class="relative isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center border-0 text-sm font-medium transition-[color,background-color,border-color,filter] duration-150 focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/30 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;&gt;[data-slot=icon]]:-mx-0.5 [&amp;&gt;[data-slot=icon]]:shrink-0 gap-x-2 px-3.5 py-1.5 sm:text-sm [&amp;&gt;[data-slot=icon]]:size-4 [&amp;&gt;[data-slot=icon]]:sm:size-3 bg-[--btn-bg] text-[--btn-text] hover:bg-[--btn-hover] rounded-full [--btn-bg:color-mix(in_srgb,hsl(var(--primary))_3%,hsl(var(--card)))] [--btn-hover:color-mix(in_srgb,hsl(var(--primary))_7%,hsl(var(--card)))] [--btn-text:theme(colors.primary)] col-start-2 justify-self-start sm:col-start-3" data-fill="soft" href="/bot/XuWFUtbBJNcGBisijI1FZ"><span class="absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 size-[max(100%,2.75rem)] -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 [@media(pointer:fine)]:hidden" aria-hidden="true"></span>Add to Grok Bot</a></div><h3 id="product-and-engineering"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#product-and-engineering">Product and Engineering</a></h3><p>Our Engineering Team Bot works from a project’s Slack channel and connects to Notion, Linear, Hex, Datadog, and Cursor. It follows product decisions, triages bug reports, creates tickets, and launches Cloud Agents to handle well-defined fixes.</p><p>We taught the Bot our shipping process through skills. It knows how to handle PR reviews, when to ask the team for help, and what evidence a change needs before it is complete. It coordinates the work across tools and agents, then reports progress and blockers in Slack.</p><p>We used this setup while building Team Bots. The Bot steered a Cursor Project that orchestrated hundreds of Cloud Agents, helping a five-person team ship more than 100 PRs a day and launch Team Bots in a few weeks.</p><div id="epd-teammate" We built Marketing Bot to make that work easier.</p><p>We gave the Bot access to our brand guidelines, blog posts, and social copy. Whenever someone shares a draft for approval in Slack, it reviews the work against our voice and latest messaging. Regional teams can get feedback and keep moving in their own time zones without waiting for an approval cycle at HQ.</p><p>For website and SEO changes, Marketing Bot carries the work from review to launch. Once a content update passes review, the Bot makes the change and posts a preview link in Slack for final sign-off. Anyone on the marketing team can ship website updates without filing a ticket or waiting on engineering, and every change goes through the same brand and SEO checks.</p><figure class="not-prose border-border my-12 border-l pl-6 sm:my-16 sm:pl-8"><blockquote class="font-display text-primary/85 text-xl leading-snug tracking-tight sm:text-2xl">“<!-- -->We’re building toward Team Bots for every marketing function. These Bots help us dig into market and customer intel, show up in AI answers, review launches, and tell us what’s working.<!-- -->”</blockquote><figcaption class="text-primary/40 mt-5 text-sm"><span Reviews any artifact against your brand guidelines and latest messaging, and takes approved website and SEO changes from review to preview and sign-off, so every region can ship on its own schedule.</p></div><a aria-label="Add Marketing Bot to Grok Bot" data-track="team-bots-blog-add-marketing-bot" class="relative isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center border-0 text-sm font-medium transition-[color,background-color,border-color,filter] duration-150 focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/30 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;&gt;[data-slot=icon]]:-mx-0.5 [&amp;&gt;[data-slot=icon]]:shrink-0 gap-x-2 px-3.5 py-1.5 sm:text-sm [&amp;&gt;[data-slot=icon]]:size-4 [&amp;&gt;[data-slot=icon]]:sm:size-3 bg-[--btn-bg] text-[--btn-text] hover:bg-[--btn-hover] rounded-full [--btn-bg:color-mix(in_srgb,hsl(var(--primary))_3%,hsl(var(--card)))] [--btn-hover:color-mix(in_srgb,hsl(var(--primary))_7%,hsl(var(--card)))] [--btn-text:theme(colors.primary)] col-start-2 justify-self-start sm:col-start-3" data-fill="soft" href="/bot/YHpL0gdPx1l98iS02wGak"><span class="absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 size-[max(100%,2.75rem)] -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 [@media(pointer:fine)]:hidden" aria-hidden="true"></span>Add to Grok Bot</a></div><h3 id="data-analytics"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#data-analytics">Data Analytics</a></h3><p>Our data analytics team receives dozens of requests each day for one-off analyses. It built Data Bot so anyone at SpaceXAI can get answers without waiting for an analyst or setting up warehouse access.</p><p>Data Bot uses shared, read-only credentials to query approved tables in Databricks. It also connects to Datadog, Hex, and Statsig to investigate questions and present the results.</p><p>The data analytics team had already spent two years building a library of skills for working with more than 45,000 tables. It gave that existing library to Data Bot, including instructions for finding the right data, analyzing feature usage for fraud, following SpaceXAI’s chart standards, and safely updating company-wide dashboards. Data Bot also remembers corrections to its queries, so what it learns from one person improves the answers it gives everyone.</p><div id="data-bot" class="not-prose bg-card my-8 grid scroll-mt-24
